sources.snippet: Today, we're officially launching MiniMax H3, a general-purpose omni-modal generation model. H3 can jointly understand multimodal contexts spanning text, images, video, and audio. It generates video with native stereo audio at up to 2K resolution and 15 seconds in length.

sources.snippet: MiniMax H3, also searched as Hailuo 3.0 / Hailuo 03 / 海螺3 / 海螺3.0, is a flagship AI video model experience for short cinematic clips. On minimaxh3.art you get a studio built around that model narrative: text-to-video, image-to-video, native 2K-class delivery, synchronized audio, multi-ratio framing, and credit-based generation.
